TileStructure.Forest.tree_projection_est.statement: (Lemma 7.2.1) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, and assume `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which provides the measure `volume` on $X$) and a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be a forest `Forest X n`, let $u \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$ with $u \in t$, and let $f, g : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to `volume`). Then $$\Big\|\int_X \overline{g(x)}\, \mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak{T}(u), f)(x)\,d\mathrm{volume}(x)\Big\|_e \le C_{7.2.1}(a)\, \big\|P_{\mathcal{J}(\mathfrak{T}(u))} |f|\big\|_{L^2}\, \big\|P_{\mathcal{L}(\mathfrak{T}(u))} |g|\big\|_{L^2},$$ where $\|\cdot\|_e$ is the extended norm in $[0,\infty]$, $\mathfrak{T}(u)$ is `t.𝔗 u`, $P_{\mathcal{C}} h$ denotes `Forest.approxOnCube 𝒞 h`, $\mathcal{J}$ and $\mathcal{L}$ are `Forest.𝓙` and `Forest.𝓛`, $|f|, |g|$ are the real-valued functions $x \mapsto \|f(x)\|$, $x \mapsto \|g(x)\|$, the $L^2$ norms are the $[0,\infty]$-valued `eLpNorm` with respect to `volume`, and $C_{7.2.1}$ is `Forest.C7_2_1`.

TileStructure.Forest.boundary_operator_b.statement: (Lemma 7.2.3) Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \to X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$, and assume `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which provides the measure `volume` on $X$) and a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)`, with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be a forest `Forest X n`, let $u \in \mathfrak{P}(X)$, and let $f : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to `volume`). Then $$\|\mathrm{boundaryOperator}_t(u, f)\|_{L^2} \le C_{7.2.3}(a)\, \|f\|_{L^2},$$ where the $L^2$ norms are the $[0,\infty]$-valued `eLpNorm` with respect to `volume`, $\mathrm{boundaryOperator}_t$ is `t.boundaryOperator`, and $C_{7.2.3}$ is `Forest.C7_2_3`.
